evidence.observation: Growth-stage baseline O2 ~4.4 ppm after clean purge down to ~5 ppm
Monotonic rise 4.4→9.4→14.6→19.8→26.2 ppm over four consecutive events, ~5 ppm/2min, with no stage or setpoint change
Ar flow steady at 100 sccm, so rising O2 is not from reduced purge flow
T at setpoint 750 °C, Pheat ~43-44%, thermal control nominal
Pressure gauge not installed (null); cannot cross-check with pressure rise/drop

args.missing_evidence: A discriminating test: step Ar purge up (e.g. 100→300 sccm) — a leak dilutes and O2 should fall roughly in proportion, whereas an outgassing/sensor-drift source would not scale with flow. Tube pressure is unavailable (gauge not installed), so the leak cannot be confirmed barometrically; post-run leak-up/helium check on the seals would settle it.
